products.name: Weights & Biases
products.note: ML experiment tracking, model registry, and artifact lineage; W&B Weave adds LLM and agent tracing, evaluation, and guardrails; acquired by CoreWeave

profile_text.body:
Weights & Biases, founded in 2017 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, describes itself as an AI developer platform that serves as a system of record for training AI models and developing AI applications. The platform covers ML experiment tracking, a model registry, and artifact lineage, and its W&B Weave component adds tracing, evaluation, and guardrails for large language models and agents. The company states that its platform is certified under ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27017:2015, and ISO/IEC 27018:2019, and is compliant with SOC 2 and HIPAA standards, with alignment to GDPR requirements and support for NIST 800-53 compliance.

The held facts note that Weights & Biases has been acquired by CoreWeave. The site's law exposure data associates the company with 161 entries in California, though no specific litigation cases are on record in the held facts.
